home.intro: The Design Verification Lab (DVLab) at the Department of Electrical Engineering, National Taiwan University, directed by Prof. Chung-Yang (Ric) Huang, focuses on formal verification, quantum circuit synthesis and optimization, and electronic design automation.

highlights.title: Research Team
highlights.desc: Led by Prof. Chung-Yang (Ric) Huang, our members span Master's, PhD, and undergraduate researchers working on formal verification, quantum computing, and EDA.

highlights.title: Research Outputs
highlights.desc: The lab has been recognized at ICCAD CAD Contest, DAC, DATE, and QCE, and continuously publishes high-quality research.

highlights.title: Recruitment & Collaboration
highlights.desc: We welcome students interested in verification, quantum circuits, and EDA, as well as academic and industrial collaboration.
